Hassle back potatoes with creamy Cajun chicken and airfried brocollini . Easy, healthy comfort meal  Potato recipe 6 medium potatoes 3 tbsp butter (melted) 2 tbsp olive oil 4–5 cloves garlic (minced) 1½ tsp paprika 1½ tsp onion granules 1½ tsp garlic granules 1 tsp dried parsley Salt & pepper 1–2 tsp all-purpose seasoning Method: Slice each potato thinly (don’t cut all the way through). Mix melted butter, olive oil, garlic, and all seasonings. Brush generously over all 6 potatoes, getting into the layers. Air fry at 180°C for 35–45 mins (depending on size). Brush with extra butter halfway through for that crispy finish. Chicken recipe  Ingredients: 1 tbsp olive oil 1½ tsp Cajun seasoning ½ tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp onion powder Method: Add the sliced chicken to a bowl. Drizzle over the olive oil. Sprinkle all the seasonings evenly. Mix well until every piece is fully coated. Let it sit for 10–15 minutes (optional, but boosts flavor). Pan-fry on medium-high heat until golden and cooked through. Cajun Sauce: 1 tbsp butter ½ onion (diced) 150–200ml heavy cream Same seasonings as chicken Instructions  In the same pan, melt butter and cook onions until soft. Add cream + seasoning, simmer until thickened. Add chicken back in and coat in sauce. #dinnerideas #recipe #easyrecipes #cooking #airfryerrecipe

Had to turn my viral baked lasagne jacket into a tray bake for four … because one potato simply isn’t enough when comfort food calls 🥔😂 This is a take on my baked lasagne style jacket potato just bigger, better, and perfect for feeding four instead of one. Fluffy crispy jackets. Rich leftover Bolognese. Creamy cheesy béchamel. Finished with a golden cheese melt. Would you share this… or keep the whole tray to yourself? 👀 🥔 Lasagne-Style Jacket Potato Tray Bake Serves 4 Ingredients Jackets • 4 large baking potatoes • Olive oil spray • Sea salt & black pepper • 40g butter Filling • 600–700g leftover Bolognese sauce Cheesy Béchamel Sauce • 40g butter • 40g plain flour • 500ml semi-skimmed milk • Black pepper • 100g mixed grated cheese • 30–40g grated Parmesan For layering • 150–200g mozzarella or mixed cheese • Extra Parmesan for topping Method 1. Cook the jacket potatoes Pierce potatoes, rub with olive oil and salt. Air fry at 180°C for 45 minutes, then another 10 minutes until crispy. Oven option: 200°C for about 1 hour until fluffy inside and crunchy outside. 2. Make the cheesy béchamel Melt butter in a pan over medium heat. Stir in flour and cook for 1 minute. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth and thickened. Season with black pepper, then stir through mixed cheese and Parmesan until melted and creamy. Set aside. 3. Assemble the tray bake Place all 4 crispy jackets into a large tray. Slice open and gently mash the centres with butter, salt and pepper. 👉 Spoon 1 tablespoon of béchamel into each potato and mix through the fluffy middle. Now layer in this order: • Add the leftover Bolognese • Pour over more béchamel sauce • Sprinkle over mozzarella or mixed cheese • Finish with a generous grating of Parmesan 4. Final melt Bake at 180°C for 10–12 minutes or air fry at 180°C for 4–5 minutes until golden, bubbling and irresistible. #foryoupagе #spud #jacketpotato #jacketpotatoes #lasagna

This is seriously one of the best appetizers I’ve ever made, and easy to throw together! 🤤 roasted tomato burrata dip with garlic bread crostinis!) 🍅🧄 Ripe bursted cherry tomatoes, stir in burrata, and scoop it all up with crispy garlic crostinis. A total flavor bomb… have the recipe ready, people WILL ask for it! 🛒You’ll Need: • cherry tomatoes • Olive oil • Salt, pepper, red pepper flakes • Garlic, parsley, oregano • Burrata • Fresh basil • Parmesan • French baguette • Butter, garlic, salt, parm (for garlic butter) 🧈 How to Make: 	1.	Add grape tomatoes to a baking dish and drizzle generously with olive oil (about halfway up). 	2.	Season with salt, pepper, red pepper flakes, garlic, parsley, and oregano. 	3.	Bake at 425°F for 20-30 mins until tomatoes burst (you can gently smash them halfway if they need some assistance in the ‘bursting’ process). 	4.	While that bakes, slice baguette, spread with garlic butter (butter, garlic, salt, parm), and toast 5–7 mins until golden. 	5.	Once you’re ready to serve, top with parm, fresh basil, and burrata. Stir it all together and serve HOT. Dip. Scoop. Repeat. Garlic Parmesan chicken pasta ✨ Ingredients  Chicken  - 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut in half - 1 tsp roasted garlic powder  - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp oregano  - 1 tsp Italian seasoning  - 1 tsp garlic and herb seasoning  - Salt to taste - 1 tbsp avocado oil (for cooking) - 1 tbsp unsalted butter (for cooking) Sauce + pasta - 14 oz fettuccine pasta  - 1 1/2 cup heavy cream - 6 tbsp unsalted butter - 1/4 cup pasta water - 7 garlic cloves (minced) - 1 shallot (minced) - 1 1/4 cups Parmesan cheese (grated)  - 1 tbsp freshly chopped parsley  - 1 1/2 tsp oregano  - 1 1/2 tsp roasted garlic powder - 1 tsp red chili flakes - Salt and pepper to taste  Instructions  - In a large bowl coat chicken breast with about 2 tsp of olive oil, seasonings, salt and mix until evenly coated. Cover and set aside for 30 minutes to marinate. - Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Add avocado oil and 1 tbsp of butter. - Sear chicken for 5 minutes per side until a golden crust forms. Deglaze pan with a little chicken broth, lower the heat, cover, and simmer until internal temperature reaches 155F. - Remove chicken from pan, cover in foil, and place into oven set warm. Pasta  - Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil. Salt it heavily. - Cook pasta according to package instructions until al dente. - Reserve at least 1/4 cup pasta water, then drain. Sauce - To the same pan (medium heat) add butter. - Sauté shallot for 1–2 minutes until soft. - Add minced garlic and cook until fragrant (about 30 seconds). - Season with oregano, garlic powder, chili flakes, salt, and black pepper. Mix until well combined and fragrant  -  Pour in heavy cream and mix  - Simmer gently for 3–5 minutes until slightly thickened. - Lower heat and stir in Parmesan  cheese and pasta water. Mix until well combined. Taste and adjust for seasonings. - Add cooked fettuccine and parsley, mixing until well coated. - Stir in an additional ¼ cup Parmesan until fully combined. - Finish with chopped parsley. - Add sliced chicken on top of pasta  - Finish with extra Parmesan, cracked pepper, or chili flakes if desired. • • • #recipes #pasta #dinnerideas #chickenrecipe #foodideas

This One Pan Chicken & Gravy is an easy and delicious 30 minute dinner!  INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breasts  Salt, pepper, garlic powder  3 tbsp butter 3 tbsp flour  2 cups chicken broth  1/2 tsp each of salt, pepper, oregano, and thyme  1 tsp each of paprika, onion powder, garlic powder  INSTRUCTIONS  Cut chicken breasts in half lengthwise to make them thinner. Season the chicken with some salt, pepper, and garlic powder (I don’t use exact measurements for this part).  In a skillet over medium high heat melt 3 tbsp of butter. Once the butter has melted add 3 tbsp of flour and stir continuously until well combined. Let cook for a few minutes while still stirring.  Add 2 cups of chicken broth and stir well. Season with salt, pepper, oregano, thyme, paprika, onion powder, and garlic powder. Stir well and when it starts bubbling add the chicken to the skillet.  Make sure the chicken is covered in the gravy, cover with a lid, and turn the heat down to medium low. Let this cook for 12-15 minutes or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of 165 degrees. My chicken was ready in 12 minutes, but they were pretty thin.  Shred the chicken and serve over mashed potatoes! Enjoy! Let me know if you try it out.  #chickenandgravy #easyrecipe #dinner #onepanmeal #chickenrecipes

HOT HONEY GROUND BEEF BOWLS 🍯🌶️ all I have to say is this one’s viral for a reason. Here’s how I made mine! Ingredients: (makes 4 bowls) 1 1/2 lbs sweet potato (680 g) peeled, diced into ~1/4” cubes salt, pepper, cinnamon - to taste 1 lb 93/7 lean ground beef 1 tbsp tomato paste (16 g) 1 tbsp taco seasoning 2 cups 2% low fat cottage cheese (452 g) 4 small avocados (400 g) 4 tbsp hot honey (84 g) Instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 425F and line a half baking sheet with parchment. 2. Add diced sweet potatoes, lightly spray with cooking spray and season with salt, pepper and a little cinnamon. Bake for 30 minutes, flipping and seasoning again halfway. 3. While potatoes are baking, make the taco beef. Heat a frying pan on medium high, add ground beef and cook, breaking apart into small pieces until fully cooked (~5 min). Drain any excess liquid. 4. Add tomato paste, taco seasoning, a splash of water and cook for 1-2 more minutes, stirring everything together. Remove from heat. 5. Build your bowl with sweet potato, taco beef, cottage cheese and fresh avocado. Finish it off with a drizzle of hot honey and enjoy! ✨ For the full printable recipe + nutrition, search 🔍 “hot honey ground beef bowls” at myproteinpantry.com or link 🔗 in my bio! 🫶🏼 #highprotein #easyrecipes #healthyfood #healthylifestyle #healthyrecipes #hothoney #beef #sweetpotato #avocado

Crispy tortilla cones filled with juicy spiced beef and topped with melted mozzarella 🧀🔥 The perfect crunchy snack or quick dinner that everyone will love. One bite and you’re hooked 🤤 Crispy Beef Cones (12 cones) Ingredients For the cones:  • 6 tortillas (25–30 cm / 10–12 inches)  • Toothpicks For the topping:  • Mozzarella cheese, 100 g  • Chopped parsley, 1 tsp For the beef mixture:  • Ground beef, 400 g(0.8lb)   • 1 yellow onion, finely chopped  • Garlic, 4 cloves, minced  • Red bell pepper, diced (about 1 small)  • Green bell pepper, diced (about 1 small)  • Tomato paste, 1 big tbsp   • Soy milk, 100 ml (~ ½ cup) Seasoning:  • Paprika, 1 tbsp  • Chili powder, 1 tsp  • Turmeric, 1 tsp  • Garlic powder, 1 tsp  • Black pepper, 1 tsp  • Garam masala, 1 tsp  • Salt, ½ tsp Instructions 1.⁠ ⁠Prepare the beef mixture:  • Heat a little oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the onion and sauté until soft.  • Add the minced garlic and cook 30 seconds until fragrant.  • Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it apart as it cooks.  • Stir in tomato paste, soy milk, diced bell peppers, and all seasonings. Cook until slightly thickened. Remove from heat and let cool slightly. 2.⁠ ⁠Prepare the cones:  • Cut tortillas in half. Roll each half into a cone shape and secure the edge with a toothpick. Baking Method:  1. Preheat oven to 190°C (375°F).  2. Place cones on a baking tray lined with parchment paper. Lightly spray with cooking spray.  3. Bake for 10–12 minutes until crispy and golden.  4. Fill each cone with the beef mixture and top with mozzarella cheese.  5. Return to oven for 5 minutes until cheese melts.  6. Garnish with parsley and serve warm. Air Fryer Method:   1. Preheat air fryer to 180°C (356°F).  2. Lightly spray cones with cooking spray and place them in the air fryer basket. Make sure they don’t touch each other.  3. Air fry for 6–8 minutes until crispy and golden.  4. Carefully fill each cone with the beef mixture and top with mozzarella cheese.  5. Air fry again for 3–4 minutes until cheese melts.  6. Garnish with parsley and serve warm. #crispybeef #quickrecipes #easyrecipes #lazydinner #beefcones

Sheet Pan Parmesan Garlic Chicken Thighs are an easy and delicious dinner!  INGREDIENTS  2 lb boneless chicken thighs  Buffalo Wild Wings Parmesan Garlic sauce  1 tsp each salt, pepper, Italian seasoning, and onion powder  2 tsp each garlic powder and smoked paprika  Small head of broccoli, chopped  24 oz baby potatoes  1 onion, sliced  Olive oil   Parmesan cheese  INSTRUCTIONS  Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F. Spray a large sheet pan with cooking spray.  Wash the baby potatoes and quarter them. Slice an onion and chop your broccoli. Be sure to leave the broccoli in slightly larger pieces. Add all of the veggies to the sheet pan and drizzle some olive oil over them. Season the veggies with about half of the seasoning blend.  Next, add the chicken thighs to a bowl and season with the rest of the seasoning. Add enough Parmesan Garlic sauce to coat the chicken. Stir until the chicken is well coated in seasoning and sauce.  Bake at 400 degrees F for about 35 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of at least 185 degrees F. Broil for just a few minutes if desired. Top everything with some shredded Parmesan cheese. Enjoy!  #sheetpanmeal #dinner #parmesangarlic #chickenthighs #easyrecipes

If there is one meal that belongs on your fall dinner table, it’s a cozy pot roast. Slow cooked until tender, served over creamy mashed potatoes and finished with a rich broth. It’s the ultimate comfort meal for fall 🍂 Full recipe down below, you can also find it in the link in my bio 🤎  Beef pot roast Ingredients: 	⁃	2-3 lb chuck roast 	⁃	1 medium white onion, sliced 	⁃	3 celery stalks, diced 	⁃	3 large carrots, sliced  	⁃	Bite size potatoes 	⁃	5 garlic cloves, minced 	⁃	Rosemary  	⁃	Thyme 	⁃	2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce 	⁃	3 tbsp tomato paste 	⁃	2 Au jus gravy packets 	⁃	6 cups beef bone broth 	⁃	3 tbsp unsalted butter 	⁃	2 tbsp onion powder 	⁃	2 tbsp garlic powder 	⁃	Salt to taste Instructions: Wash and prep all of your vegetables. Peel and dice the carrots, slice the onion, mince the garlic, and dice the celery. Season the chuck roast to your liking. I used onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Make sure to season all sides of the roast. Add oil to a Dutch oven and sear the roast on all sides for 3–4 minutes per side. Remove the roast from the pot and set aside. Add the celery and onion to the pot and cook over medium heat until the onion has caramelized. Add the minced garlic last to prevent it from burning. Add the tomato paste, Worcestershire sauce, and gravy packets. Add ½ cup of beef broth to deglaze the pot, then pour in the remaining broth. Add the seasonings and taste to make sure everything is seasoned to your liking. Add the roast back to the pot, along with the carrots, potatoes, butter, and a bunch of rosemary and thyme tied together with butcher’s twine. Cover and place in a 350°F oven for 3 hours. About 30 minutes before the roast is finished, prepare the mashed potatoes. To assemble, add a bed of mashed potatoes to a plate, then top with the roast, potatoes, and carrots. Finish with some of the broth and fresh or dried parsley. Enjoy! 🤎 #fall #fallrecipes #potroast #cozyvibes #fallvibes

INGREDIENTS Chicken & Marinade 2 lb boneless, skinless chicken thighs 1 lemon, zested ⅛ cup soy sauce ¼ cup maple syrup 1 tbsp garlic powder 1 tbsp smoked paprika Glaze 2 tbsp butter 4 cloves garlic, minced ½ cup maple syrup ⅓ cup soy sauce 2 tbsp rice vinegar 3 tsp Momofuku chili oil 1 tsp cornstarch + 2 tbsp water (slurry) INSTRUCTIONS 1.In a bowl add chicken thighs and season with soy sauce, maple syrup, lemon zest, garlic powder, and smoked paprika, coat well. 2.Preheat the air fryer to 400°F. Place thighs in a single layer and cook for 15 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and cooked through (165°F internal temp). 3.Make glaze: In a saucepan, melt butter. Add garlic and cook until fragrant. Stir in maple syrup, soy, vinegar, and chili. Simmer for 3-4 minutes. Stir in slurry and cook until sticky and glossy. 4.Baste & finish: Add cooked chicken thighs to the glaze, toss to coat, 5.Serve: Drizzle extra glaze over the chicken serve over rice and veggies and enjoy!

⇩ Full Recipe 🍗 ⇩ Macros per 1 meal prep: Protein: 40g Carbs: 87g Fat: 8g Calories: 585 Ingredients per 2 servings (makes 2 meal preps): Chicken - 1lb chicken thigh, boneless, skinless, raw - 2 tsp salt - 2 tsp black pepper - 1/4 cup cornstarch - 1/3 second spray oil - 1 tsp sesame seeds -1 green onion Soy Glaze Sauce - 2.5 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tbsp oyster sauce - 2.5 tbsp honey - 1.5 tbsp minced garlic Cucumber Salad - 2 Persian cucumbers - 2 tsp salt - 1.5 tbsp rice vinegar - 2 tsp brown sugar - 1/2 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tsp sesame seeds 1.5 cup cooked rice How to make it yourself: 1. Dice your cucumbers into thin circles. 2. Lay your chicken thighs flat, season with salt and pepper, and coat evenly with cornstarch on both sides 3. In a bowl, mixed together, soy sauce, oyster sauce, honey, and minced garlic to make your sauce. 4. On a pan coated with spray oil on medium heat, cook your chicken until golden brown, crispy on both sides, and cooked through. 5. Remove the cooked chicken from the pan and pour in your sauce to let it simmer for 45 seconds the add back in your chicken and let it coat the sauce for a minute then quickly remove. 6. In a bowl, mix together your sliced cucumbers with salt. Let it sit for 15 minutes until the excess liquid drains from the cucumbers. 7. Remove the excess liquid from the cucumbers and rinse the cucumbers with water. 8. Pat dry the cucumbers and add them into a bowl with rice vinegar, brown sugar, soy sauce, and sesame seeds and mix well to make your salad. 9. In a meal prep container, add 1/2 your steamed rice, 1/2 your cucumber salad, and 1/2 your chicken optionally topped with sesame seeds and sliced green onions. 10. Pro tip: when meal prepping to re-heat, make sure to put your salad & meat into separate ziploc bags to avoid getting the rice soggy. When ready to eat, microwave the rice with a wet paper towel first to get it steamed, then add in your meat and microwave till warm, and finally add your salad to preserve the crunch and enjoy! 📩 Save this Soy Glazed Chicken recipe to make for later! #highprotein #lowcaloriemeals #mealprep #mealplan #healthyrecipe #weightlossmeals #asianfood #chicken

Strawberry Nutella Brownies 🍓🤎 Perfect brownies for summer!  (recipe makes an 8x8 pan) Ingredients:  10 tbsp (140g) unsalted butter, melted 1 cup (200g) granulated sugar ¼ cup (50g) brown sugar, packed  2 eggs, room temp 1 tsp vanilla extract ½ cup + 2 tbsp (56g) unsweetened cocoa powder ½ tsp salt 1 tbsp (13g) vegetable oil ½ cup (63g) all purpose flour, spooned & leveled or weighed (don’t pack it in) ¾ cup chocolate chips 190g (~⅔ cup) Nutella  Topping: Strawberry slices, patted dry (as many as you want/enough to cover the top) Nutella (to spread over the top & drizzle)  Instructions: Line an 8x8 pan with parchment paper. Spread the nutella onto the parchment into a thin, even square the size of the pan. Freeze for at least 30 minutes or until frozen solid. Preheat oven to 325°F and line/grease an 8x8 pan with parchment. In a large bowl, whisk melted butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until smooth. Add eggs and vanilla, then whisk vigorously for 1-2 minutes. Stir in cocoa powder and salt until fully combined. Mix in oil, then gently fold in the flour until just combined (don’t over mix). Fold in chocolate chips. Spread half the batter into the greased pan. Place the frozen nutella sheet on top of it. Then, spread the remaining batter over it to cover the nutella layer completely. Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until a toothpick near the center comes out with no wet batter. It should just come out with a little nutella & slightly moist crumbs. Let the brownies cool completely. Spread a thin layer of nutella over the cooled brownies, add strawberry slices (patted dry) all over the top, and drizzle with more nutella.  Best enjoyed fresh!  #bakingrecipe #brownies #chocolatestrawberries #nutella #recipe

Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

Creamy Pesto Chicken Pasta Bake ✨ My most viral recipe of 2024!  What a year it’s been. I’m truly so grateful for all the love and support you’ve shown me this year. Cheers to a delicious 2025!  Here’s how to make it: 1lb pasta of choice 1/2 cup sun-dried tomatoes + oil 1lb chicken 1 tbsp butter 1/2 yellow onion, diced Salt and pepper, to taste 1 tsp red pepper flakes (to taste) 1 tsp smoked paprika (to taste) 1 tsp oregano (to taste) 6-8 cloves of garlic, minced (to taste) 2 cups heavy cream (room temp) 1-2 cups cooked broccoli  2 handfuls spinach 6-8 oz freshly shredded parmesan cheese (divided) 8 oz freshly shredded mozzarella (divided) 1/2 cup pesto, to taste (I recommend Costco brand) Parsley to garnish  1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Place the cream on the counter to come to room temp. 2. Boil your noodles in salted water a few minutes less than package instructions (al dente). Drain and set aside.  3. In a large oven-safe saucepan or dutch oven, heat 1 tbsp of sun-dried tomato oil over medium heat. Cook the chicken until it's no longer pink, then remove it from the pan and set it aside. Let it rest for a few minutes before cutting into bite-sized pieces. 4. In the same pan, melt the butter and add salt, pepper, red pepper, paprika, and oregano. Stir to toast, then toss in the onion and sauté for about 4 minutes. Add the garlic and cook for another 30 seconds. 5. Turn heat to low, pour in the heavy cream and stir. Let it simmer for a couple of minutes to thicken slightly. 6. Add half of the parmesan and 1 cup of mozzarella cheese,  stir until the cheese is melted. 7. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes, cooked broccoli, spinach, chicken, cooked pasta, and pesto. 8. Top with the remaining mozzarella and parmesan cheese.  9. Bake at 350°F for 15 minutes, then broil for another 5 minutes, or until the top is golden and bubbly. 10. Sprinkle with fresh parsley, a little more parmesan, and enjoy! #pastabake #chickenpesto #pesto #pestopasta #pestochicken #pasta #pastarecipe #easyrecipe #easyrecipes #easymeal #easydinner #dinnerideas #dinner #foodtok #cooking

Hot Honey Chicken Pasta 🍯🔥 the viral recipe with over 60+ million views, 20/10 hits every time! Recipe: Chicken Tenders • 1 lb chicken tenderloins • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp creole seasoning • 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional, adjust to spice) • 1 tsp all purpose seasoning • 1 sazon packet • 1–2 cups buttermilk • ⅛ cup jalapeño or pickle juice • 3 cups all-purpose flour (season with same seasonings) Hot Honey Sauce • ½ cup buffalo sauce • ¼ cup honey • ⅛ cup hot sauce (optional) Pasta • 1 lb penne pasta • 2 tbsp unsalted butter • 2 garlic cloves, finely minced • ½ yellow onion, finely chopped • 1 ½ cups heavy cream • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp creole seasoning • 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional) • 1 tsp all purpose seasoning • 1 tsp black pepper • Grated mozzarella • Grated Parmesan Instructions 1. Season chicken tenderloins add in buttermilk and jalapeño/pickle juice then marinate for at least 30 minutes to an hour.  2. Coat chicken in seasoned flour set aside on wire rack and rest for 10 minutes before frying. Fry at 350°F until golden brown and crispy. Set aside and let cool on a wire rack. 3. In a sauce pan, add 1 tbsp of unsalted butter, buffalo sauce, honey, and hot sauce and simmer until fully combined. Then toss chicken in the hot honey sauce. 4. In a skillet, melt butter and sauté garlic and onion until fragrant. Pour in heavy cream and stir in all seasonings. 5. Add mozzarella and Parmesan until melted and creamy, then toss in cooked pasta. 6. Top creamy pasta with hot honey chicken and extra sauce if desired and enjoy :) #hothoneychickenpasta #hothoney #chickenpasta #pasta #fypシ

videos.caption: Crispy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Wraps🍗🧀🌯 The flavours are absolutely phenomenal, one of the best wraps made using a sheet pan. Low effort, minimal cleanup and incredibly delicious🔥 Great to serve for large groups/gatherings at home Macros Per Wrap (10 Total) 423 Calories | 41g Protein | 25g Carbs | 18g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Wraps) Garlic Parmesan Chicken - 600g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, cut into cubes - 600g Raw Chicken Breast, cut into cubes - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 200g Grated Parmesan - 6 Tsp Olive Oil - Avocado Cooking Spray (use before baking) Garlic Pamesan Creamy Sauce - 350g Light Evaporated Milk - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1 Tsp Garlic Powder - 1 Tsp Paprika - 80g Grated Parmesan - 100g Light Cream Cheese - 15g Light Butter Wraps & Filling - 10 Low Carb Wraps (Brand: Mission) - Shredded Lettuce - Chopped Tomatoes - Chopped Onions 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Slice chicken breast and thighs into cubes. Add seasonings with grated parmesan cheese and drizzle of olive oil. Mix until well coated. 2. In a pan on low heat, add light butter with seasonings. Toast for a minute before adding evaporated milk, extra Parmesan and cream cheese. Stir till smooth and creamy. 3. Line a sheet pan with parchment paper, spread marinated chicken evenly (do not overcrowd), add light layer of cooking spray then bake in a preheated oven for 20-22 mins at 200C until crispy. 4. While chicken is still hot, add extra parmesan and parsley. Mix well until coated and extra cheesy. 5. Assemble the wraps with shredded lettuce, onion, tomato, crispy chicken and sauce. ENJOY! Storage and Reheating Tips - Store chicken and creamy sauce in separate containers in the fridge. - When ready to eat, just warm up chicken in oven/air fryer for 4-5 mins 180C / 370F. Warm up sauce in a pan, serve on a wrap with fresh lettuce and enjoy . . . . #garlicparmesan #chickenwrap #chickenrecipes #highprotein #healthyrecipes

Chicken alfredo tacos 🌮  For the chicken 1 lb boneless chicken breast, cut into small pieces  Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper  1 tsp smoked paprika powder  1 tbsp garlic powder  1 tsp onion powder  1/2 tsp Italian seasoning  2 tbsp lemon juice  2 tbsp oil for marinating + more for cooking For the Alfredo sauce: 2 tbsp butter 1 tbsp all purpose flour  2 cloves fresh garlic, minced  1 cup unsweetened heavy whipping cream Salt to taste  1/2 tsp black pepper  1 tsp garlic powder  1/2 cup milk 3/4 cup Parmesan cheese, freshly grated  To assemble  15-16 mini tacos 1 cup mozzarella cheese  Oil for lightly frying the tacos 1/4 cup parsley, freshly chopped for garnish  Method  Marinate the chicken with salt, black pepper, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, Italian seasoning, lemon juice, and oil for 20–30 minutes. Cook until golden and set aside. In the same pan, melt the butter and sauté the garlic. Whisk in the flour, then add the heavy cream and milk. Season with salt, black pepper, and garlic powder. Simmer until slightly thickened, then stir in the Parmesan until smooth.  Add the cooked chicken to half of the sauce and toss to coat. Reserve half for later . Fill each tortilla with mozzarella, the chicken Alfredo mixture, and a little more mozzarella. Fold and pan-fry until golden and crispy on both sides. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve with extra Alfredo sauce for dipping. #recipe #tacos #alfredochicken

Butter Chicken Recipe 🍛🔥👇🏼  For chicken:   2 chicken breast   3 tbsp Greek yogurt   Minced ginger   1 tsp garlic powder, paprika, cayenne, salt, cumin   1/2 lemon   For sauce:   1 tbsp butter   1/2 onion   2 fresh cloves garlic   1/2 tsp paprika, cumin, salt and chicken bouillon powder (optional)   2 1/4 cup tomato passata   1-2 tsp sugar   1 cup heavy cream   2 tbsp butter   cilantro   First, we’re going to cut the chicken into small cubes and season it with the spices, fresh ginger, lemon, and Greek yogurt. Then in a pan, add oil and fry the chicken.   Meanwhile, finely chop the onion and garlic.   Once the chicken is ready, remove it from the pan. In the same pan, add a small piece of butter and fry the onion, garlic, and spices together for 5 minutes over low heat until softened. Then add the tomato passata, sugar, and heavy cream. Mix very well and cook for a couple of minutes, then add two small pieces of butter to make it extra creamy. Finally, add the fried chicken back in, mix everything together, and top with cilantro and a little heavy cream. Serve it with white rice and naan bread.   👀 Remember that seasonings are always to taste, so don’t be afraid to add more if needed. If it tastes too acidic from the tomato sauce, don’t forget to add sugar to balance the flavors. #butterchicken #easyrecipe #foodie

Crispy pasta tubes filled with a light Philadelphia cream and dipped in coffee – one of my favorite desserts! ☕✨ Ingredients: - 250 g long pasta tubes - Oil for frying - 400 ml heavy whipping cream (33–35%) - 1½ packs Philadelphia cream cheese (about 300–350 g) - 80–120 g powdered sugar - 1 tsp vanilla sugar or vanilla extract - 150–200 ml strong, chilled coffee - Cocoa powder or grated chocolate for topping Instructions: 1. Fry the pasta tubes in hot oil until golden and crispy. Let them cool completely. 2. Whip the cold heavy cream until soft peaks form. 3. Mix the Philadelphia cream cheese with the powdered sugar and vanilla. 4. Gently fold the whipped cream into the cream cheese mixture. 5. Quickly dip the pasta tubes into the cold coffee for 1–2 seconds. 6. Pipe the cream into both ends of each tube. 7. Dust with cocoa powder or grated chocolate and chill for 20–30 minutes before serving. #EasyDessert #CoffeeDessert #HomemadeTreat #CreamCheese #DessertLover

🤖 THREEHALVES — THE CENTAUR ROBOT Threehalves is a 7-foot-tall teleoperated robot developed by Satyress. Its design combines a human-like torso and arms with a powerful four-legged chassis, creating a mechanical centaur built for environments that are too dangerous for humans. The idea behind Threehalves is simple: instead of sending a person into extreme heat, unstable terrain, darkness, hazardous industrial environments or disaster zones, a skilled operator can control the robot remotely and perform the work from a safer location. Unlike many humanoid robots, Threehalves is designed around tools and equipment that humans already use. Its modular limbs and quick-connect system allow it to be adapted for different tasks, while its four-legged platform provides stability on difficult terrain. The most unsettling part is probably its appearance. With its enormous size, humanoid body, four mechanical legs and distinctive horned head, Threehalves looks less like a traditional industrial machine and more like something from a science-fiction horror movie. But behind the terrifying design is a serious engineering concept: putting the machine in danger instead of the human. Threehalves is still a developing robotics project, but it represents a strange glimpse into a future where dangerous jobs could be performed remotely — with a human controlling the machine from a distance. And honestly… it might be one of the creepiest robots ever built. 👁️ #threehalves #robot #baal #satyress #horrortok

HEALTHIER banana bread choco chip cookies 🍌🍪 1/2 cup salted butter 1/3 cup maple syrup 1 medium ripe banana, mashed well 1 large egg  1/2 tsp vanilla extract 1 3/4 cups almond flour 1 tsp baking soda 1/4 tsp salt 2/3 cup of chocolate chips Sea salt to top Melt the butter in a small saucepan over medium heat. Stir continuously until its bubbling and browned, about 5-7 minutes. Remove and let cool for 20 minutes. Add the cooled browned butter, maple syrup and banana to a large bowl and whisk until smooth. Whisk in the egg and vanilla until combined. Fold in the almond flour, baking soda and salt until fully combined. The dough should be wet almost like a banana bread batter. Transfer to the fridge to firm up for 15 minutes while the oven preheats.  Preheat oven to 375F and line a large baking sheet with parchment paper. Fold in the chocolate chips until just combined. Scoop 12 cookies onto the baking sheet. Bake for 8-11 minutes until outsides are golden and center is still soft. Let cool for 10 minutes before transferring to a wire rack. #bananabreadcookies #chocolatechipcookie #brownbuttercookies #brownbutterbananabreadcookies #brownbutterchocolatechipcookies

Ingredients: * 350 g pasta * 250 g salmon fillet * 200 g feta cheese * 200 g cherry tomatoes * 2 handfuls baby spinach * 2 cloves garlic, minced * 2 tbsp olive oil * 1 tsp Italian herbs * Salt & black pepper to taste Instructions: 1. Add the salmon, feta, cherry tomatoes, garlic, olive oil, and Italian herbs to a baking dish. 2. Bake at 200°C (400°F) for 20–25 minutes, until the salmon is cooked through. 3. Meanwhile, cook the pasta according to the package instructions. 4. Remove the baking dish from the oven and mix everything together until the feta creates a creamy sauce and the salmon flakes apart. 5. Start by seasoning your diced chicken breast with 1 tsp each of salt, onion powder, smoked paprika & garlic powder then add 1 tsp of olive oil & mix well. 2. Cook the chicken on medium/high heat for 4 min each side or until cooked through, once the chicken is cooked take it off the heat & add 25g of honey with 85g of bbq sauce. 3. Mix well to combine until the chicken is coated in the sauce. 4. Start cooking 320g of pasta (uncooked weight) in boiling water according to package directions. 5. While the pasta is cooking to a pan on medium heat add 340ml Fat Free Evaporated Milk, 80g light cream cheese, 1.5 tsp chicken stock powder, 100g light grated cheddar cheese & continue stirring until the sauce is fully combined & smooth/creamy. 6. Add the cooked & drained pasta to the Mac & cheese sauce then mix until the pasta is fully coated. 7. Steak Loaded Potato Skins🔥 For those of you asking about the app, just search “Osta” on the App Store or Google Play 🫶 Crispy, cheesy potato skins loaded with juicy steak, chipotle sour cream & fresh chives… 🤤 Inspo from the goats @chefmikekubiesa & @burnt_pellet_bbq !! For the Potatoes: -5 large russet potatoes -1/4 cup olive oil -1 tbsp salt For the Filling: -Scooped potato flesh -1/2 cup milk, warmed -1/3 cup butter, softened -1/2 cup sour cream -1 1/2 cups sharp cheddar, grated -1/4 cup fresh chives, chopped -Seasoning salt, to taste For Frying & Topping: -Neutral oil, for frying -Triple cheddar @tillamook, grated For the Steak: -Ribeye or New York strip -Salt & black pepper For the Chipotle Sour Cream (Optional): -1 cup sour cream -1–2 chipotle peppers in adobo -2 garlic cloves -1 tbsp lime juice -1/2 tsp salt -Milk, as needed Instructions: 1. Wash & dry potatoes. Rub with olive oil, season with salt & bake at 425°F (220°C) for 50–60 mins until fork-tender. Let cool slightly. 2. Meanwhile, blend all chipotle sour cream ingredients until smooth, adding a splash of milk to thin as needed. Refrigerate. 3. Halve potatoes lengthwise & scoop the flesh into a bowl, leaving about 1/4 inch around the skins. Mash with warm milk, butter, sour cream, cheddar, chives & seasoning salt to taste. 4. Heat neutral oil to 350°F (175°C). Fry the empty skins in batches for 2–3 mins until golden & crispy, then transfer to a wire rack. 5. Stuff the skins with the potato filling, top with triple cheddar & bake at 350°F (175°C) for 15 mins until bubbling & golden. 6. Season steak generously with salt & pepper, then grill or pan-sear to your desired doneness. Rest 5–10 mins, then slice against the grain into bite-sized pieces. 7. Load the skins with steak, chipotle sour cream & fresh chives. Enjoy!! #dinnerideas #cookingathometiktoktv #recipe #cooking

We had many people in our comments who assumed we were just random people who bought a tiger cub and many people asking where they can get a tiger. We want to address this because it’s very important. Rick is not just a normal person with a tiger. Rick owns a USDA licensed zoo and Mowgli is not a personal pet. Mowgli came from another zoo and was not purchased as a pet. The reason Mowgli is inside the house (which is on the zoo property) is because he is not fully vaccinated and we will not allow him outside until our vet clears us for that. Anyone who is wanting a pet tiger needs to know that you cannot legally own one as a pet. Also, this is not Rick’s first Tiger. You can go and see Kai, our female, on our page. Rick has extensive experience with big cats and raising them. You can however enjoy how cute he is on our social media! We will NEVER have tiger encounters available and no visitors will ever be allowed to touch him or interact with him. When he is older and cleared to go outside you can see him in his enclosure if you visit the zoo. We hope that clears a few things up!

videos.caption: Honey Garlic Chicken! 🍯 🧄  Sticky, sweet, garlicky, and comes together so easy… this one’s a weeknight winner every time!! @Courtney Cook made my recipe the other day and it made me want it all over again!! Serve it over rice with a veggie, so good y’all.  Ingredients:  • 3 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces  • ½ tbsp garlic salt  • 1 tbsp black pepper  • ¼ cup cornstarch (plus a little extra if you want more crunch)  • 2–3 tbsp vegetable oil (for frying) Sauce:  • ½ cup honey  • ¼ cup soy sauce  • 1 tbsp ginger paste  • 2–3 tbsp minced garlic To Finish:  • Sesame seeds  • Green onions, sliced ⸻ Instructions:  1. Season the chicken In a large bowl, add chicken, garlic salt, black pepper, and cornstarch. Toss until everything is well coated. (Add a little extra cornstarch if you want it extra crispy.)  2. Cook the chicken Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add chicken in batches and cook until browned on both sides with a light crust. Don’t overcrowd the pan. MARRY ME MASH 🥔✨ Recipe below ⬇️ This is the ultimate recipe for luxurious mashed potato. Ultra-smooth, buttery, garlic-thyme infused, finished with white pepper and nutmeg. Make no mistake - this is pure indulgence, and it will make your guests so silent at the table. Marry Me Mash: Peel and cube 1kg Maris Piper potatoes. Add to cold salted water, bring to the boil, then simmer gently until completely tender. Drain and leave to steam dry for 20-30 minutes (this step is key for texture). Meanwhile, gently simmer 200ml whole milk and 200ml double cream with 4 chopped garlic cloves and 3-4 thyme sprigs for 30 minutes to infuse. Strain and keep warm. Pass the dried potatoes through a ricer, then fold through 150g melted butter. For extra smoothness, push through a fine mesh sieve. Add the warm infused cream one ladle at a time until silky and smooth but still holding its shape. Season with fine salt, white pepper and a small grating of nutmeg. Taste and adjust. Bonus recipe - Braised Short Rib (perfect with this mash): Season 3-4 large beef short ribs generously with salt and pepper and sear in a hot casserole pot with 1 tbsp oil until deeply browned. Remove. In the same pot soften 1 diced onion, 2 diced celery sticks and 2 diced carrots. Add 2 tbsp tomato purée, 3 sliced garlic cloves, 3 thyme sprigs and 2 bay leaves. Deglaze with 500ml red wine, reduce slightly, then add enough beef stock (around 750ml-1L) to fully submerge the ribs. Return the ribs, cover and cook at 130°C for 4 hours until spoon tender. Remove the ribs, strain and remove the fat from the sauce (use a separator jug if you have one). Pass through a fine sieve and then reduce it until glossy and thick enough to coat the back of a spoon. Return the ribs to the sauce and baste. Silky mash. Sticky, rich beef. Absolute comfort food - elevated. #mash #shortrib #cooking #recipe #food

The high-protein, low-carb dinner I wish I knew about sooner… and best part, it only takes 15 minutes!! #RECIPE Enoki Beef Rolls 🍄 Ingredients (3-4 servings): 1 lb thinly sliced beef (I used “shabu shabu beef”) 7 oz enoki mushrooms 1 white onion, thinly sliced 1 tbsp oil (avocado oil preferred) 2 eggs, whisked Garnish: chopped green onions, sesame seeds Sauce: 1/3 cup water 1/4 cup soy sauce 1 tbsp sesame oil 1 garlic clove, minced Dash of pepper 🥩 Instructions: Prep the mushrooms – Trim the bottom 1-2 inches off the enoki mushrooms, rinse, and separate into small bundles. Roll it up – Lay out a slice of beef and roll each enoki bundle tightly inside. Repeat until all are wrapped. Make the sauce – Mix all sauce ingredients in a bowl and set aside. Sauté the onions – Heat oil in a large skillet over med-high heat, add onions, and cook for 3min until softened. Cook the rolls – Place the beef rolls over the onions in a single layer, pour in the sauce, cover, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low-med and simmer for 3min (until beef is cooked through). Add the eggs – Uncover, pour whisked eggs over the rolls, cover again, and cook for 1min.  Finish & serve – Salt to taste. Remove from heat, garnish with green onions and sesame seeds. Enjoy! #creatorsearchinsights

Cinnamon rolls… made in 20 minutes, and every bite is the center of the cinnamon Roll In depth recipe with pictures on substack!!! 🛒 Ingredients Dough 1 cup (130g) all purpose flour 1 tsp baking powder 1/4 tsp salt 1 tsp cinnamon 1/3 cup (80ml) milk (or half milk, half heavy cream) 1 tsp vanilla 1 tbsp melted butter Coating 1 tbsp melted butter 3 tbsp sugar 1-2 tsp cinnamon Vanilla Bean Glaze ✨ 4 tbsp powdered sugar 2 tsp heavy cream 1/2 tsp vanilla Vanilla bean or vanilla bean paste 👨‍🍳 Instructions 1️⃣ Preheat oven to 375°F and grease or line your pan 2️⃣ In a bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, salt, and cinnamon 3️⃣ Warm milk slightly, then mix in vanilla and melted butter 4️⃣ Pour wet into dry and mix until a soft dough forms, stop as soon as it comes together, don’t overmix 5️⃣ Lightly flour your surface, roll dough into a log, flatten slightly, and cut into 20 even bites 6️⃣ Toss each piece in melted butter, then coat fully in cinnamon sugar 7️⃣ Place in pan in a single layer with a little space between each, no stacking 8️⃣ Bake 9 to 10 minutes, until lightly golden, don’t overbake 9️⃣ While baking, mix glaze until smooth, adjust thickness if needed 🔟 Let bites cool 1 to 2 minutes, drizzle glaze over the top while warm, and enjoy ⏱ Time & Servings Prep 10 min Cook 10 min Serves 2 to 3 🔥 Pro Tip Mix just until the dough comes together, overmixing is what makes these dense instead of soft and pillowy. Just to clarify, this video was never meant to be racist in any way. I was speaking purely from an artistic perspective. As I'm starting to learn coloring, I naturally find some skin tones more challenging to render than others. That doesn't mean I like them any less. In fact, both my mom's and my dad's sides of the family are Black. My mom herself has dark skin, so why would I dislike the same skin tone as my own family? The same goes for hair textures. I have naturally curly/coily hair, and from an artistic point of view, I personally find it more difficult to draw and render than straight hair. That doesn't mean I don't like it—in fact, I love my hair. It's simply about the technical challenge of drawing and coloring different features, nothing more. Please don't confuse artistic difficulty with personal preference or prejudice. They're two completely different things.  #dessin #black #fyp #drawing #fypシ゚

Complete dinner in under 30 minutes✨ One pot, simple ingredients, minimal cleanup, and a dinner everyone actually gets excited about. Juicy chicken thighs, cozy penne pasta, and the freshest, creamiest side salad. These are the kinds of meals that end up on repeat in my kitchen because they’re easy, comforting, and just so good🥰 Ingredients 🐓🍝🥗 One pot chicken & pasta 1½ pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs/breast 1 onion, sliced ¼ cup olive oil 1 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon paprika 1 teaspoon garlic powder ½ teaspoon black pepper 1 package 16 oz penne pasta  4 cups chicken broth or any broth you love ½ cup tomato paste Side salad 🥒🍅🥑 4 Persian cucumbers, chopped About a cup of cherry tomatoes  1 shallot  1 avocado  Olive oil Fresh lemon juice  Fresh lime juice  Salt and pepper Instructions Place the chicken thighs in a bowl. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt, paprika, garlic powder, and black pepper. Mix until evenly coated. Heat a large pot over medium heat. Add the chicken and sear for a few minutes on each side until golden. Scatter the sliced onion right over the chicken and let it soften in all the flavor. In a separate bowl or measuring cup, whisk together the broth and tomato paste until smooth. Once the chicken is nicely browned, add the pasta directly into the pot. Pour the tomato broth mixture right over the chicken and pasta and bring everything to a boil. Cover, reduce to a simmer, and cook for about 10 minutes until the pasta is tender and the chicken is fully cooked through. While everything cooks, chop the cucumbers cucumbers, cherry tomatoes, shallot, and avocado. Drizzle with olive oil and fresh lemon and lime juice, season with salt and pepper, and toss. That’s it. One pot, one fresh salad, and a full comforting dinner on the table in under 30 minutes💛 #sivanskitchen #easyrecipes #onepotmeal #dinnerideas #quickmeals

videos.caption: Crockpot Chicken Pasta Ingredients • 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts • 1 tsp salt • 1 tsp black pepper • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tbsp Kinder’s Buttery Garlic & Herb Seasoning • 1 jar marinara sauce (24 oz) • 1 jar Alfredo sauce (15 oz) • 1 block cream cheese (8 oz) • 3 cloves garlic, minced • 1 bag shredded mozzarella cheese (8 oz) • Parsley flakes, for garnish Instructions 1. Add the chicken breasts to the crockpot and season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and Kinder’s Buttery Garlic & Herb Seasoning. 2. Pour in the marinara sauce and Alfredo sauce. Add the cream cheese and minced garlic, then gently mix everything together. 3. Cover and cook on HIGH for 3 hours, or until the chicken is fully cooked and tender. 4. Remove the chicken, shred it with two forks, and return it to the crockpot. 5. Add the shredded mozzarella cheese and stir until the cheese is melted and everything is creamy and combined. 6. Top with parsley flakes and serve. #crockpotrecipes #chickenpasta #slowcookerrecipes #easyrecipes #comfortfood

Cook the pasta:     Bring a large pot of heavily salted water to a boil.     Cook the spaghetti until al dente.     Reserve at least 250ml pasta water before draining. 2. Build the sauce:     Add the olive oil to a large pan over medium heat.     Add the sliced garlic and chilli flakes.     Cook gently until the garlic turns lightly golden.     Do not let it burn. 3. Emulsify:     Add the cooked pasta directly to the pan.     Add a splash of pasta water.     Toss continuously until the oil and water form a silky sauce. 4. Finish:     Remove from the heat.     Stir through the chopped parsley.     Taste and adjust seasoning if needed. 5. Strawberry Pull-Apart Bread 🍓✨ Dough: 3 cups all-purpose flour (360g) 5 tbsp melted butter (71g) 3 tbsp granulated sugar (38g) 1 tsp salt (6g) 2¼ tsp active dry yeast (7g) 1 large egg (50g) ¾ cup warm milk (180g) 1 tsp vanilla extract Simple Glaze: 1 cup powdered sugar (120g) 1–2 tbsp milk (15–30g) 1 tbsp melted butter (14g) Splash of vanilla extract Strawberry Compote Ingredients:  300g strawberries (about 2 cups, chopped) 75–90g granulated sugar (6–7 tbsp) 1 tbsp lemon juice 10–12g cornstarch (1–1½ tbsp) 30g water (2 tbsp) Instructions: In a bowl, mix warm milk, sugar, and yeast and let sit for 8–10 minutes until foamy, then add the egg, melted butter, and vanilla and mix until combined; add in the flour and salt and knead for about 8–10 minutes until smooth, then cover and let rise for 1 hour or until doubled. Meanwhile, make the strawberry compote by cooking strawberries, sugar, and lemon juice over medium heat until soft and juicy (about 5–7 minutes), lightly mash, then stir in the cornstarch mixed with water and cook until thickened, then let cool completely. Roll the dough into a rectangle, spread the strawberry compote evenly over the surface, cut into strips, stack them, and slice into pieces, then place upright into a greased loaf pan, cover and let rise for another 30 minutes before baking at 350°F (175°C) for 35–45 minutes until golden, then mix the glaze ingredients and drizzle over the warm bread. #breadmaking #strawberry #pullapartbread #baking #recipes

One Pan Cheesy Parmesan Garlic Chicken & Rice 😮‍💨 INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breast, cut into cubes  2 tbsp butter  1 onion, chopped  1/2 tsp each of salt and pepper 1 tsp each of smoked paprika, onion powder, and Italian seasoning   1 tbsp minced garlic BWW Parmesan Garlic Sauce  2 cups of chicken broth  1 cup white jasmine rice, rinsed   1 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese  2 oz cream cheese 4 pieces of bacon, cooked and crumbled Dried parsley  INSTRUCTIONS  If you don’t have any bacon leftover from breakfast cook your bacon, drain the grease, and chop it into small pieces. To keep this recipe even easier you could use bacon bits  Cut 1 lb of chicken into small pieces. Add butter to a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and spread out evenly in pan. Add the chopped onion and season with salt, pepper, paprika, onion powder, and Italian seasoning.  Once the chicken is almost cooked add the minced garlic and add 2-3 tbsp of Parmesan garlic sauce to the pan and stir. Add the rinsed rice to the center of the skillet and let toast for a couple of minutes. Add the chicken broth to the skillet and stir well. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium-low, and cover with a lid.  Let cook covered for about 15-20 minutes or until rice is cooked. Add about a cup of shredded cheese and the cream cheese. Stir well.  Top with more cheese and the crumbled bacon. Cover with the lid to let the cheese melt or pop it in the oven under the broiler for just a few minutes.  Top with dried parsley.  Enjoy! Let me know if you try it out! #easyrecipes #chicken #onepanmeal

Chinese humanoid robots broke records set by humans, including Usain Bolt's 100m sprint world record, on the opening day of the Olympics-like World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing on Saturday. More than 2,000 humanoid robots were participating in the event, organisers said. In a 100-metre sprint, a humanoid robot achieved a result of 9.39 seconds, beating the human record of 9.58 seconds set by Jamaican athlete Bolt in 2009. In a standing high jump, a humanoid robot was able to reach 2.88m, well above the 0.95m best result by a humanoid in last year’s first edition of the games. It surpassed the human high jump record of 2.45m set by Cuba’s Javier Sotomayor in 1993. The five-day games, now in their second year, are a spectacle demonstrating China’s rapid progress in advanced robotics as the technology race with the US heats up. There are 51 events and more than 1,000 competitions taking place, including running, table tennis and football. For more news, visit @sbsnews_au (link in bio).

Recipes makes 6 servings: 1 serving is 477 calories, 57g protein 18 fat 16 carb Cheesy Buffalo Bacon Chicken and Potatoes Ingredients: * 3 medium russet potatoes * 32 oz. cubed raw skinless chicken * 1 cup Frank’s Red Hot Buffalo Sauce * 120g reduced fat cheddar cheese * 120g reduced fat mozzarella cheese * 14 slices center cut bacon * 60g 1/3 reduced fat cream cheese * Salt, pepper, onion powder, garlic powder, paprika Instructions: 1. Prepare the Potatoes:  * Wash and dice the russet potatoes into bite-sized pieces. Toss with olive oil, salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika. 2. Air Fry the Potatoes:  * Preheat the air fryer to 400°F (200°C). Place the seasoned potatoes in the air fryer basket and cook for 15-20 minutes, shaking halfway through, until golden and crispy. 3. Cook the Bacon:  * In a large skillet, cook the bacon over medium heat until crispy. Remove and drain on paper towels, then chop into small pieces. 4. Cook the Chicken:  * In the same skillet, remove excess bacon fat, leaving about 1 tablespoon. Add the cubed chicken and season with salt, pepper, onion powder, garlic powder, and paprika. Add Buffalo Sauce:  * Stir in the Frank’s Red Hot Buffalo Sauce and cream cheese into the cooked chicken. Mix until the cream cheese is fully combined and the sauce is thick. 6. in a large bowl combine your creamy buffalo chicken with your chopped bacon, 140g reduced fat cheese and stir in as it melts.  7. Evenly distribute your cooked potato and buffalo chicken into 6 containers. Refrigerate for 2-3 days or freeze and enjoy later.

Korean Popcorn Chicken 🍿🍗 For all of you asking about the app, search “Osta” on the app or Google play store ‼️🫶 The crispiest korean porocrn chicken… sweet, spicy and so simple. You can also make this in the air fryer!!🔥 For the Chicken: -2 lb chicken thighs or breasts, cut into 1 inch cubes -2 eggs -2 tbsp rice vinegar -6 garlic cloves, minced -1 tbsp fresh ginger, grated -Seasonings: 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp gochugaru (optional) -1/4 cup cornstarch -1/2 cup all-purpose flour -Neutral oil, for frying For the Sauce: -1.5 tbsp gochujang -2 tsp sesame seeds -3 tbsp ketchup -4 garlic cloves, minced -1.5 tbsp honey -3 tbsp butter -1 tbsp rice vinegar -1 tbsp soy sauce -2 tsp sesame oil -1 tsp gochugaru (optional) Garnish: -Sesame seeds -Green onions, sliced Instructions: 1. In a bowl, combine chicken with eggs, vinegar, garlic, ginger, & seasonings. Mix well & marinate as long as you wish (1 hour ideal, 1 min works). →For frying: add the cornstarch & flour directly into the same bowl and mix until evenly coated & sticky. →For air frying: do NOT add flour yet. You’ll coat it separately in step 2. 2. For frying: skip this step & go to step 3. For air frying: in a new bowl, mix cornstarch & flour. Remove chicken from marinade then toss in dry ingredients until fully coated. Press lightly so it sticks. 3. For frying: heat neutral oil to 350°F / 175°C. Fry in batches for 7–8 mins until golden and crispy, transfer to a rack. 4. For air frying: oil the basket & spray/brush the chicken with oil. Cook at 375°F for 8 mins, flip, cook for 6–8 mins more until crispy & cooked through. Work in batches. 5. In a pan over medium-low heat, combine gochujang, ketchup, sesame seeds, garlic, honey, rice vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil, & optional gochugaru. Bring to a simmer, add butter, stir until melted, remove from heat. 6. Add the chicken directly to the sauce & toss OR in a mixing bowl, combine your desired amount of sauce with the chicken to control how saucy it gets. 7. Serve over jasmine rice, garnish with sesame seeds & green onions. Enjoy :) #recipesoftiktok #chicken #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv

This is an art exhibit called “Can’t Help Myself.”
 It’s programmed to try to contain the hydraulic fluid that’s constantly leaking out and required to
 keep itself running - If too much escapes, it will die.
 The saddest part is that the creators gave the robot the ability to do ‘happy dances’ for
 spectators while the spill was contained.
 When the project was first launched in 2016 it danced around spending most of its time
 interacting with the crowd since it could quickly pull back the small spillage.
 Over time, the leak was designed to get worse.
 By the time this video was taken, the leaking fluid had become unmanageable.
 The robot no longer has any time to dance as it struggles desperately to keep itself alive, living its
 last days in a never-ending cycle between sustaining life and bleeding out.
 I think the reason this demonstration hits so hard is because it’s a feeling we can all relate to.
 Earlier in life, we had the time and the energy to be creative and spend time with our loved ones.
 Now, as time goes on, not only do we need to work harder to support ourselves… But thanks to
 economic changes, it’s getting more and more difficult, and for many people the situation is
 becoming desperate.
 But - people aren’t robots.
 We have the ability to recognize our situation and change our programming.

Creamy Cajun Chicken Pasta 🔥 One-pot & ready in under 20 minutes… juicy cajun chicken served with the creamiest garlic parmesan sauce 🤤 If there is one piece of cookware you need in your kitchen, it’s gotta be the @Made In Cookware Saucier!  I’ve been using Made In for a long time and the Saucier is my favorite piece to cook with… it can do everything your sauce pan can do, but better!  If you’re looking to upgrade your cookware, I linked my favorite Made In pieces in my bio. For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Save at least 1/2 cup pasta water before draining (‼️). Set pasta aside. 3. Heat a large pan or pot over medium heat for a few mins. Add 2 tbsp olive oil, increase to medium-high, add the chicken. Sear for 3–4 mins per side until golden, then reduce heat if needed and cook through. Set aside to rest. 4. Reduce heat to medium. In the same pan, melt the butter, scraping up all that fond. Add the shallot & cook for 5 mins, add the garlic, cook for 1 more min. 5. Reduce heat to medium-low, slowly pour in the cream. Add the seasonings & simmer for 2–3 mins. Reduce heat to low, add the parmesan & stir until smooth. 6. Add the pasta & 1/4 cup pasta water, toss over low heat for 1–2 mins until the sauce is silky. Add more pasta water as needed. Slice the chicken, add it on top, and finish with more parm and fresh parsley!  #easydinner #pasta #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv

An Easy Date Night One Pan Meal From Me to You 🍲 Cooking is a skill like anything else. The more effort and focus you give to it the easier it will be and the better you will get. If you are a beginner here’s an easy place to start.  — Ingredients: - 1lb boneless skinless chicken thighs - 2 cups of white rice - 2 cups of chicken stock  - avocado oil  - tbsp chilli crunch oil  - 1 half of a medium sized yellow onion (diced) - 4-6 cloves of minced garlic  - parsley (chopped) - juice of 1/2 a lemon - parmesan cheese - seasoning blend (salt, pepper, onion powder, mushroom powder, smoked paprika, cayenne pepper (small amount)) METHOD: - chop up everything and WASH YOUR RICE - season your chicken  - pan medium-high heat  - add avocado oil  - add chicken thighs “skin” side down - get a good sear and flip (we aren’t trying to cook them all the way right now) - turn heat down to half way between medium and low - cook chicken 1-2 more minutes and remove - add in chili crisp oil, onion and garlic  - sautee 1-2 minutes and then turn heat back up  - add your washed rice and toss together till water has evaporated (rice looks dry) - add a couple pinches of salt  - once incorporated add 2cups of chicken broth  - bring to a boil and add back in your chicken thighs - turn heat to low and cover for 12 minutes - finish with a squeeze of lemon, chopped paraely, and parmesean cheese on top  ENJOY! 🤝

This was a freaking 1000/10 🤤✨ Apple Pie Pull Apart Bread 🍎🥧🍂 Ingredients: Apple Filling: * 3 apples, peeled and diced * 2 tbsp butter * ⅓ cup brown sugar * 1 tsp cinnamon * ¼ tsp nutmeg * 1 tsp vanilla * 1 tbsp lemon juice * 1 tbsp cornstarch * 2 tbsp water * Pinch of salt Bread * 2 cans refrigerated biscuits * 1 stick butter, melted * 1 cup white sugar * 1 tbsp cinnamon Instructions: 1. Make the apple filling: Cook diced apples with butter, brown sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg, lemon juice, and salt for 6–8 minutes. Mix cornstarch with water and stir it in. Cook 1–2 more minutes until thick. Stir in vanilla and let cool. 2. Make the cinnamon sugar: Mix the white sugar and cinnamon together. 3. Prepare the biscuits: Open each biscuit in half, creating two thinner pieces. 4. Build the layers: Dip each biscuit half in melted butter, then coat it in the cinnamon sugar. Place the pieces into a greased loaf pan, layering them with the apple filling between sections. 5. Bake: Bake at 350°F for 1 hour, or until the center is fully baked.       (The glaze on top is just 1 cup powdered sugar with 2-3 tbsp milk)    #easyrecipe #dessertrecipes #baking #fallrecipes #fallbaking

Arsenio’s Chicken Alfredo Mac N Cheese 👑🧀🍗 Chicken: 1 tsp onion powder 2 tbsp Cajun seasoning 1 tbsp black pepper 2 tsp salt Cube your chicken, season it, then cook it halfway on the stove before finishing it in the oven. Roux: ½ cup butter (113g) ½ cup flour (60g) 3 garlic cloves 1 chicken bouillon cube, grated Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper 1 tsp smoked paprika Melt the butter, add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Whisk in the flour and cook for 60–90 seconds. Add the grated chicken bouillon cube, then slowly add your milk and cream while whisking until it thickens. Sauce: 3 cups whole milk (720g) 1 cup heavy cream (240g) 3–4 cups shredded cheese (340–450g) — fontina, mozzarella, cheddar Take it off the heat and add your cheese 1 cup at a time until smooth. Pasta: 2 packs Barilla pasta (340g each) Boil the pasta just under al dente, drain and mix it into your cheese sauce. Add the chicken and mix everything together. Put it into a baking dish and cover the top with extra cheese… measure that with your eyes 😂 Bake at 375°F for 15 minutes, then broil on high for 3 minutes. Plate it up and finish with freshly grated Parmesan. 🧀

Raising Cane’s at Home 🐔🏠 For all of you asking - the app link for Osta is in my bio or you can search “Osta Recipes” on the App Store or Google Play store ‼️🫶 Crispy buttermilk chicken tenders, addictive Cane’s sauce and fluffy texas toast… all at home! For the Chicken: -2 lbs (0.9 kg) chicken breast, sliced into strips (or use tenderloins) -2 cups buttermilk -1/3 cup pickle juice -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper -Neutral oil, for frying Flour Mixture: -2 cups all-purpose flour +1/2 cup cornstarch -1 tsp baking powder -Seasonings: 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper Cane’s Sauce -1/2 cup mayonnaise -1/4 cup ketchup -2 tsp Worcestershire sauce -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp seasoning salt Instructions: 1. Slice the chicken breasts into strips about 1 inch thick and 3–4 inches long (roughly tender-sized). In a bowl, whisk together the buttermilk, pickle juice, and chicken seasonings until fully combined. Add the chicken and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight for extra tender chicken. 2. In a large bowl, combine the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and flour mixture seasonings. Mix. 3. Add neutral oil to a large pot or deep skillet until it is about 2–3 inches deep. Heat the oil to 350°F / 175°C. Keeping the oil around this temperature ensures crispy chicken without burning the coating. 4. Drizzle a little buttermilk marinade into the flour mixture and stir to create flaky, crispy bits. Shake excess marinade off the chicken, then coat each piece thoroughly in the flour mixture. Shake off any extra flour and gently place into the hot oil. 5. Don’t touch them for the first 1–2 mins, that’s how you get the perfect crust. Fry for 7–10 mins, or until golden brown and cooked through. Transfer the chicken to a paper towel-lined rack to drain. 6. In a bowl, combine all the sauce ingredients then refrigerate. 7. Serve the chicken with a side of sauce, texas toast and fries! We’re now in the nothin sounds good for dinner season so here’s an easy one pan meal my family loves!  INGREDIENTS 1 lb of chicken breast, cut into cubes  1 tbsp olive oil  1/2 tsp each salt and pepper 2 tsp chili powder 1 tsp each of cumin and dried cilantro 1 tbsp minced garlic  10 oz can of Rotel (not drained)  8 oz can of tomato sauce  1 1/2 cups of chicken broth 1 cup of long grain white rice (uncooked & rinsed)  2 cups of shredded Colby Jack cheese  Sour cream  Cilantro  Buffalo Wild Wing’s Southwest Ranch INSTRUCTIONS.  Add the chicken with 1 tbsp of oil to a large skillet over medium-high heat, add all seasonings, and cook until the chicken is cooked through.  Add the untrained Rotel, tomato sauce, minced garlic, chicken broth, and uncooked rice to the skillet. Stir well, make sure to bring the whole skillet to a boil, cover with a lid, and cook on medium-low heat for about 15-20 minutes or until rice is cooked (I stirred it once about half way through).  Top with shredded Colby Jack cheese and let it melt or pop in the oven on broil. Serve and top with sour cream, cilantro, and Southwest Ranch sauce. Serve with tortilla chips. Enjoy!  #easyrecipes #tacorice #onepanmeal #dinner

Buffalo Chicken Crispy Tacos 🔥 Crispy, saucy buffalo chicken tacos with a creamy garlic lime aioli that you’ll want to dunk everything in 🌮 Lately I’ve been using @Primal Kitchen Foods pure avocado oil to get that golden, high-heat sear. It’s neutral in flavor and perfect for cooking without burning. Now available at Walmart. #PrimalKitchenPartner #primalkitchen Ingredients For the Chicken: -1.5 lb boneless, skinless chicken thighs, very finely diced -Seasonings: 1 tbsp garlic powder, 1 tbsp onion powder, 1 tbsp paprika, 1 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper -3 tbsp avocado oil (divided) from Primal Kitchen -2 tbsp honey -2/3 cup Primal Kitchen’s buffalo sauce -1/4 cup fresh cilantro or parsley, finely chopped Addictive Garlic Lime Sauce: -1/2 cup sour cream -1/2 cup mayonnaise -1 small jalapeño, deseeded (optional) -1 1/2 cups cilantro, leaves and stems -4 to 5 garlic cloves -2 tsp black pepper -1 tsp salt -Juice of 1 lime For Assembly: -10 to 12 mini tortillas -2 cups shredded mozzarella -Avocado oil, for frying  Instructions: 1. Add the diced chicken to a large bowl with all the seasonings and 1 tbsp avocado oil. Mix until every piece is coated. 2. Heat the remaining 2 tbsp avocado oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook, stirring occasionally, until  golden and crispy, about 8 minutes. Remove from heat and add-in buffalo sauce, honey, and cilantro. Mix together. 3. Add all sauce ingredients to a blender or food processor. Blend until smooth, bright green, and very hard not to taste repeatedly. 4. Lay a tortilla flat. Sprinkle a thin layer of mozzarella, add 2 to 3 tbsp buffalo chicken, then another light sprinkle of cheese. Fold in half. Repeat until all tacos are built. 5. Heat a thin layer of avocado oil in a pan over medium-low heat. Cook tacos in batches until golden and crispy on both sides, adding more oil as needed. 6. Serve hot, generously drizzle with garlic lime aioli, add extra cilantro if you like, and enjoy the crunch. Dunk responsibly.

The perfect recipe to satisfy your takeout craving 😋 ➡️ Recipe: Beijing Beef  Serves 3-4 * 1lb skirt steak or flank steak, thinly sliced against the grain  * 1 small red bell pepper, large diced  * 1 medium onion, large diced  * 4-5 garlic cloves, finely minced  * 1 tsp grated ginger  * Frying oil  Beef marinade— * 1/2 cup cornstarch  * 2 tbsp water (add an extra 1/2tbsp if needed  * 1 tsp sesame oil  * 1/2 tsp garlic powder * 1/4 tsp baking soda  * 1/4 tsp kosher salt  * 1/8 tsp white or black pepper  Sauce— * 3 tbsp rice vinegar or 2 tbsp white vinegar  * 2 tbsp oyster sauce  * 2 tbsp ketchup  * 1 tbsp hoisin sauce  * 1 1/2 tbsp soy sauce  * 1 1/2 tbsp sugar  * 1/2-1 tsp chili flakes (optional)  1. In a bowl, combine sesame, oil, garlic powder, baking soda, kosher salt, and white pepper with flank steak. Mix well then add cornstarch and water, mix until the meat is craggly and set aside.  2. In a small bowl, combine vinegar, oyster sauce, ketchup, hoisin sauce, soy sauce, sugar, and chili flakes. Mix well and set aside.  3. In a large pan, heat enough oil for a shallow fry to 350°F. Carefully place marinated beef to fry and ensure each slice does not stick together for an even fry. Fry for 3-4 mins or until beef is cooked through and coated and crispy. Strain the beef and set aside. 4. In a large wok, heat 1-2 tbsp oil. Add onions and bell peppers sauté for 30 seconds or just before it turns translucent. Then add garlic and ginger and sauté for another 30 secs-1 min. 5. Make a pit in the center and pour all of the sauce. Toss with onions and bell peppers for about. Then add the fried beef. Toss until everything is combined and evenly coated with the sauce. Serve and enjoy!  #easyrecipes #chinesefood #beijingbeef #dinnerideas #takeout

Meals for Weight-loss: Ep 8 Honey Garlic Chicken 640 cals, 58g protein, 54 carbs, 12 fat per serving Makes 4 servings You can find all my recipes link in bio!  You would think this is unhealthy but its perfect for meal prep and its SO GOOD! Here is how I made it: 1. Add 1.5 cups jasmine rice and 2.25 cups water to a rice cooker and cook according to the rice cooker settings. 2. In a large bowl, combine 800 g chicken breast, 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 6 cloves minced garlic, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 tbsp cornstarch, and 1 tsp black pepper. Mix until the chicken is evenly coated and let it marinate for 20-30 minutes. 3. Air fry the chicken at 400°F for 10-12 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through, until cooked through and lightly caramelized. 4. Heat 1 tbsp avocado oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Add 4 cloves minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Add 600 g broccoli florets and stir-fry for 4-5 minutes. Pour in 2-3 tbsp water, cover for 1 minute, then uncover and season with 1 tbsp soy sauce, ½ tsp black pepper, and a pinch of salt. Toss everything together for another 1-2 minutes, then set aside. 5. In the same wok, add 4 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 6 cloves minced garlic, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, and ¾ cup water. Bring to a simmer. Mix 2 tsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp water and stir it into the sauce. Cook for 1-2 minutes until the sauce thickens. Add the cooked chicken and toss until every piece is coated. 6. Divide the rice, broccoli, and honey garlic chicken between 4 meal prep containers. Finish with sliced green onions and sesame seeds. Now it’s time to enjoy! #healthyrecipes #mealprep #healthyfoodshare #amateurprochef #takeoutrecipes

dinner with a dietitian: street corn inspired chicken rice bowls..you don’t even have to turn on the oven. 👌🏻 Flavor + Nutrition are my top 2 priorities when it comes to dinner. What I love about these: Balanced meal with lots of nutrition. Great for meal prep. Easy to customize. Full recipe below ⬇️ or grab it here: https://mallorythedietitian.com/street-corn-chicken-rice-bowl/ INGREDIENTS For Chicken • 1½ lb chicken breasts (or thighs) • 3 Tbsp extra virgin olive oil (1 for marinating + 2 for cooking) • 1½ tsp chili powder • 1 tsp each: smoked paprika, garlic powder • ½ tsp onion powder • ½ tsp kosher salt • ¼ tsp black pepper For Dressing • 1 c Greek yogurt • 2 Tbsp mayo • 1 lime, zest & juice • ½ tsp each: chili powder, smoked paprika, garlic powder • ½ tsp kosher salt • ¼ tsp black pepper • 1-3 Tbsp water (as needed to thin it out) For Street Corn • 3 c corn, cooked • ½ red bell pepper, chopped • 1 small jalapeno, chopped • ¼ c red onion, chopped • ¼ c cilantro, chopped • ¼ c cotija cheese For Cilantro Lime Rice • 1 c jasmine rice, uncooked • 1 Tbsp extra virgin olive oil • ½ c cilantro, chopped • 2 Tbsp lime juice • ½ tsp each: garlic powder, kosher salt • ¼ tsp black pepper For Assembling (opt) • romaine  • avo • tomatoes DIRECTIONS 1. Prep chicken: Cut chicken into cubes. Coat in 1 Tbsp olive oil + seasonings. Set aside to let marinade. 2. Make rice: cook rice according to package. Mix in cilantro, lime, olive oil, gp, s&p. 3. Prep Dressing: make the Elote dressing by mixing the ingredients listed. 4. Make Street Corn: remove corn from cob & chop the jalapeno, red pepper, onion, & cilantro. Add everything to a  bowl. Top w/cotija cheese & half the dressing. 5. Cook chicken: heat a skillet on medium-high. Add olive oil until hot. Add chicken & cook 3-4 min on one side. Flip & cook another 3-4 min until cooked to internal temp 165℉ (75°C) 6. Assemble: Add romaine (opt), rice, chicken & corn to a bowl. Top with more dressing, lime, & fave toppings!  NUTRITION (per bowl, makes 6)* 470 cal, 34g pro, 43g carb, 19g fat *nutrition info based on serving size rec: ½ c chicken, ½ c rice, ¾ c corn salad, 2 Tbsp dressing, ½ c romaine (opt) Follow for healthy recipes! 4:53 PM 8/29/26, my best friend went to Doggy Heaven ❤️ Saturday morning, we woke up to an emergency and rushed to the ER. Hemangiosarcoma, an aggressive cancer, had progressed so quickly that within a few hours, I had to say goodbye. We got to share a few special moments before.  If you knew me at any point over the past 10 years, you probably had the pleasure of meeting my Stella girl. Her favorite thing to do was meet new people, besides giving high fives at any chance she got. It was her only trick, but she was the best at it and always wanted to show it off. I adopted Stella when she was 11 months old at a shelter in Gainesville, FL. I was a freshman in college, not knowing what I was getting myself into. Nothing bad, just the most fun, love filled 10 years with a little creature that I could ever imagine. From Florida to New York, she was always by my side as long as the place let a dog in. If you knew us, you knew the bond we had. We were two peas in a pod. She was the most unique and silly dog I’ve ever known, and if you ever met her, you got to feel her love. She was constantly smiling, asking for belly rubs or high fives, and her ears told you exactly which silly goofy mood she was in. Her favorite activity, besides playing in the snow, was sitting and watching the waves by the water, something we got to do for a very long time on her last night. A memory I’ll always cherish.  She was my best friend. I’ll miss her forever. Every moment the rest of my life. She’ll always be on my mind. When it’s my time to go, bury me with the biggest stick you can find, I have a long overdue play date with my girl.

Crockpot Parmesan Garlic Chicken & Potatoes are an easy weeknight dinner!  INGREDIENTS 1 lb chicken breasts 1 bag baby potatoes, quartered (or 4-5 russet potatoes cut into cubes)  olive oil + salt, pepper, garlic powder, smoked paprika (for potatoes) 1/2 tsp each of salt and pepper 1 tsp each of paprika, onion powder, and Italian seasoning  1 tbsp minced garlic  Buffalo Wild Wings Parmesan Garlic Sauce (just enough to cover chicken) 1 cup of shredded mozzarella cheese Dried parsley Parmesan cheese  INSTRUCTIONS  Quarter one bag of baby potatoes and cut chicken into cubes. Spray a crockpot with cooking spray.  Add potatoes the crockpot. Season with olive oil, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and smoked paprika (I don’t use exact measurements for this part). Add minced garlic and stir potatoes and seasonings well.  Add the chicken on top of the potatoes. Season chicken with 1/2 tsp each of salt and pepper, 1 tsp each of smoked paprika, onion powder, and Italian seasoning.  Add some garlic Parmesan sauce. I use just enough of the sauce to cover the chicken. You can always add more sauce if needed once everything is cooked.  Cook on low for about 6 hours or until potatoes are cooked to your liking. Stir everything well.  Top with shredded mozzarella cheese and let it sit just until the cheese is melted.  Top with some dried parsley and Parmesan cheese. Enjoy!  #easyrecipes #dinner #crockpot

Creamy Chipotle Chicken & Potatoes🍗🍟🧀 One of the most indulgent meal prep recipes, so creamy, rich in flavour and packed with protein. Using a sheet pan is a game changer for batch cooking🔥 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 548 Calories | 51g Protein | 52g Carbs | 17g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6 Servings) Chipotle Chicken Marinade - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, trim excess fat - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Parsley - 3 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Cumin - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 100g Chipotle Paste - 1 and 1/2 Limes, juiced - 30g or 6 Tsp Olive Oil Let this marinate overnight if possible, way more flavor! Crispy Seasoned Potatoes - 1300g Raw Yellow Potatoes, cubed - 2.5 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Onion Powder - Avocado Cooking Spray, heavy pass Creamy Chipotle Sauce - 20g Light Butter - 150-200g Red Onion, finely chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 60-80g Chipotle Paste (depends how spicy you want it) - 400g Light Evaporated Milk - 110g Light Cream Cheese - Freshly Chopped Parsley, garnish 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add seasonings, chipotle paste, lime juice, and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a large pan on low, add butter and chopped red onion. Cook for 5-7 mins until softened and lightly browned. Add seasonings and chipotle paste, mix, and cook for another 5 mins until caramelised. 3. Keep the heat low, add evaporated milk and cream cheese. Stir continuously until smooth, rich, and creamy. 4. Cube up potatoes, add seasoning and cooking spray, then mix well. Spread on a lined sheet pan and roast at 200C / 390F for 25 mins until golden and crispy. Season with salt, then fold into the sauce with fresh parsley until fully coated. 5. Spread marinated chicken on sheet pan, oven bake 25 mins 200C / 390F until golden and juicy. Cut into cubes, serve with creamy potatoes and ENJOY! . . . . #chipotle #chickenrecipes #mealprep #highprotein #healthyrecipes
